name: fx
description: Interactive JSON viewer with JavaScript expressions and live editing - terminal-based JSON explorer with syntax highlighting

fx.description: Interactive JSON viewer and processor with JavaScript expressions and live editing capabilities - perfect for exploring large JSON files with syntax highlighting
fx.usage:
fx data.json # Interactive JSON browser with syntax highlighting
cat data.json | fx '.users[0].name' # Extract specific field
echo '{"a":1}' | fx 'this.b = 2; this' # Transform JSON with live editing
fx data.json '.filter(x => x.age > 30)' # Filter arrays interactively
